verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents interact with the Stripe API. Billing data such as subscriptions and invoices is exposed through that API, so an agent can query billing state directly. The evidence does not show the MCP tools or API calls that answer the story's specific questions; MRR and performance metrics appear only in Dashboard analytics, not as agent-queryable endpoints. Missing for 10: documented MCP tools or endpoints for MRR, delinquent-account and upcoming-renewal queries, invoice-listing tools for agents, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent billing queries.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can answer questions about my billing state — MRR, delinquent accounts, upcoming renewals, a customer's invoices — by querying the platform directly

citations.quote: Let your AI agents interact with the Stripe API by using our MCP server.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.stripe.com/mcp
Create a new subscription in the Dashboard or with the Subscriptions API.
